'''''Feared''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] created by [[Ob Khaddor]], a mysterious [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] who disappeared shortly after [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] put a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] on his head. The painting was [[red]] hued and depicted a female [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] with ribbons around her neck and head against a background of vertical stripes. The word "Feared," written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] lettering, appeared vertically down the right side of the image.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Feared'' was one of the items available through the "rare loot system" in [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] which was released on [[June 26]], [[2003]]<ref name="Start">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20030617.html|text=''Galaxies'' to Release June 26}}</ref> and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The system allowed for a chance of extra, rare loot to drop from any enemy, with the loot increasing in value the more difficult the enemy was to defeat. The crystal known as ''[[Cunning of Tyranus]]'' was another item from this system. The name of the creating artist is spelled Ob Khaddar in the item's description.<ref name="SWG" />
